integrity: Proof and 116 finite graph/palette checks support the same stated theorem. All computations are corroboration; no independent audit or certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to finite connected complete multipartite graphs and the ordinary distance-based packing-colouring sequence, not arbitrary graphs or S-sequences.
Counts distinguish named colour labels, permit unused colours, and take unordered witnessing partitions.
The motivating preprint full text was not accessible; its abstract was read and historical priority remains provisional.
title: Complete packing–domatic colour spectra and witness partitions of complete multipartite graphs
